name: dataiku-excel-coach
description: Learn Dataiku through a guided migration of your Excel workbook, using the existing Dataiku Headless and migration skills.

interface.longDescription: Learn Dataiku by migrating a process from your own Excel workbook. Confirm the business logic, select a migration pace, and inspect visual recipes with guided Excel comparisons and practice. Requires the separately installed Dataiku Headless and Dataiku Migrate plugins and access to a Dataiku instance.
defaultPrompt: Help me learn Dataiku by migrating one process from my Excel workbook.
